proof_object: Carrier-uniformity audit for a P vs NP transfer route.
target_commitment: A lower-bound transfer whose carrier remains advice-free and target-preserving.
proposed_move: State the carrier, uniform decoder, reduction type, and first hidden-advice falsifier.

conceptual_depth.evidence: The packet targets carrier transparency and uniformity rather than global P vs NP rhetoric.
conceptual_depth.missing_evidence: Needs a proof of the uniform decoder.
conceptual_depth.demotion_trigger: Demote if the carrier hides advice.

explanatory_power.evidence: Explains why carrier transfer is blocked by advice and quantifier discipline.
explanatory_power.demotion_trigger: Demote if no mechanism is named.

unification_power.evidence: Links lower-bound transfer, advice accounting, and barrier status.
unification_power.demotion_trigger: Demote if route families are blurred.

mechanism_specificity.evidence: Names carrier, decoder, reduction type, and hidden-advice defeater.

compression.evidence: Compresses repeated carrier optimism into one uniformity gate.
compression.demotion_trigger: Demote if it does not affect queueing.

generativity.evidence: Creates decoder, advice, and barrier follow-up obligations.

transfer_reach.evidence: Transfer reach is support-only until the decoder is proved.
transfer_reach.demotion_trigger: Demote if advertised as P != NP.

falsifiability.evidence: A hidden nonuniform row selector is the first falsifier.
falsifiability.demotion_trigger: Demote if no hidden-advice test exists.

boundary_sharpness.evidence: The packet explicitly does not claim P != NP.
boundary_sharpness.demotion_trigger: Demote if main conjecture language appears.

literature_displacement.evidence: Prior-art relation is pending but the gate asks the right comparison question.
literature_displacement.missing_evidence: Needs hardness magnification and barrier comparison.
literature_displacement.demotion_trigger: Demote if known barriers are cited generically.

transfer_substance_audit.definition_expansion_test: Pass for support-only status: the carrier is not allowed to define the target lower bound into existence.
transfer_substance_audit.independent_source_object_test: Source lower-bound object is stated independently of the carrier.
transfer_substance_audit.independent_target_property_test: Target consequence is stated as an external lower-bound transfer claim.
transfer_substance_audit.nontrivial_hypothesis_test: Uniform decoder and advice-free carrier are required hypotheses.
transfer_substance_audit.source_variation_test: Changing decoder uniformity can break transfer.
transfer_substance_audit.stress_case_test: Hidden-advice row selection is the stress regime.
transfer_substance_audit.failure_case_test: A nonuniform row selector gives a falsifier to advice-free transfer.
transfer_substance_audit.consequence_delta: The next cycle knows carrier optimism is support-only until uniformity is proved.
transfer_substance_audit.prior_art_delta: Comparison must separate this from known hardness magnification transfer barriers.
transfer_substance_audit.repair_certificate: Prove the advice-free uniform decoder and run barrier-specificity review.

declarative_learning_event.attempted_inference: Transfer lower-bound evidence through a carrier.
declarative_learning_event.observed_result: Carrier transfer remains blocked until uniformity and advice discipline are certified.
declarative_learning_event.learned_constraint: Carrier arguments are support-only without an advice-free uniform decoder.
declarative_learning_event.scope_condition: Route-level P vs NP carrier only.
declarative_learning_event.invalidated_generalization: Do not treat carrier existence as lower-bound transfer.
declarative_learning_event.future_routing_effect: Route to quantifier-uniformity and transfer-substance audit.

demotion_trigger: Demote if carrier definition includes the lower-bound target property.
